```{r}
# load libraries
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
source(here::here("src/parse_sample_id.R"))
```


```{r}
varmint_files <- list.files(
  path = here::here("data/b19_variants/"),
  pattern = "*tsv",
  full.names = T
)

rm(varm_dt)
for (tsv in varmint_files) {
  stem1 <- basename(tsv)
  
  if (exists("varm_dt")) {
    temp_dt <- fread(
      tsv,
      sep = "\t",
      header = T
    ) |> 
      mutate(file = stem1)
    varm_dt <- rbind(varm_dt, temp_dt)
  } else {
    varm_dt <- fread(
      tsv,
      sep = "\t",
      header = T
    ) |> 
      mutate(file = stem1)
  }
}

varm_dt <- varm_dt |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = gsub(".b19.variant_stats.tsv", "", file)
  ) |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = sample_ID, 
    delim = ".", 
    names = c("sample_ID", "Pool")
  ) |>
  filter(
    Pool %in% c("p1733", "p1849", "p1894", "p2058"),
    !grepl("Hybrid", sample_ID),
    !grepl("-B$", sample_ID)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    join_col = case_when(
      grepl("XX-0", sample_ID) ~ str_replace(sample_ID, "^([^-]*-[^-]*).*$", "\\1"),
      #grepl("HELTHY|MODAD|SEVAD", sample_ID) ~ gsub("-A$", "", sample_ID),
      TRUE ~ sample_ID
    )
  )
```

```{r}
head(varm_dt)
```

```{r}
varm_dt |> distinct(join_col)
```




```{r}
donor_meta_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/donors/simple_donor_meta1.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
anti_join(
  varm_dt,
  donor_meta_dt,
  by = "join_col"
)
```


```{r}
merge_dt <- merge(
  varm_dt,
  donor_meta_dt,
  by = "join_col"
) |>
  mutate(uid = paste0(patient_ID, ".", sample_ID))
```

```{r}
head(merge_dt)
```

```{r}
merge_dt |>
  filter(AF >0, AF < 1)
```



```{r}
muts_p <- merge_dt |>
  mutate(
    alt_seq = case_when(
      allele_type == "alt" & AF < 0.5 ~ "",
      is.na(alt_seq) ~ "",
      TRUE ~ alt_seq
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pos, y = uid, fill = alt_seq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "grey75", "#52777A","#542437","#C02942","#D95B43","#ECD078"
  )) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(patient_ID), cols = vars(contig), scale = "free_y", space = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
muts_p
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  here::here("charts/b19_mutation_plot1.pdf"),
  muts_p,
  height = 12,
  width = 8
)

ggsave(
  here::here("charts/b19_mutation_plot1.png"),
  muts_p,
  height = 12,
  width = 8
)
```
